treadmill — 跑步机；比喻原地踏步、没有进展的状态
'I feel like I've been running on a treadmill,' she told her teacher, Mr.

skeptical — 怀疑的，持怀疑态度的
Mei was skeptical at first.

high-frequency — 高频的，经常发生的
First, Mei would focus on 'high-frequency errors' — mistakes she made again and again.

eliminate — 消除，排除
A good plan doesn't eliminate mistakes.

noticeably — 明显地，显著地
By February, her speaking had improved noticeably.

reflection — 反思，思考
At the end of the three months, Mei wrote a short reflection.

scheduled — 安排好的，定期的
Chen explained that forgetting is normal, and scheduled review is more effective than constant new input.

depth — 深度，深刻程度
Depth beats width at your level.' He showed her a simple checklist for exam preparation: 1) Check your error log before each practice test.
